aldous.instruct: male, young adult, moderate pitch, british accent
aldous.line: You found them, Captain. You choose. I'm too close to it. I'll do what you say. I mean it.

ansel.instruct: male, elderly, very low pitch, british accent
ansel.line: You're taking the thief into your army? ... Well. He's the Commons' trouble now, and not ours. And the cats came home.

arvo.instruct: male, young adult, high pitch, russian accent
arvo.line: You have greenlings. Abel says so. I want to come off. And I want to ride with you while I do, so nobody here has to watch.

aurel.instruct: male, middle-aged, low pitch, british accent
aurel.line: The court finds that the accused wears the marks of the Guild. The law of Lorne is the law. He hangs at dawn.

brannoc.instruct: male, middle-aged, very low pitch, american accent
brannoc.line: Every child we pull out of a hatchery goes in a book at our camp. Name, village, the cart they came on. Some of the names we've had off Guild clerks.

cartwarden.instruct: male, middle-aged, low pitch, american accent
cartwarden.line: Stand aside. This cart carries indentured property of the Brood Guild.

corran.instruct: male, young adult, low pitch, american accent
corran.line: I can't feel anything, Rhea. Do you understand? I can't feel the heat. I can go in where you can't.

councillor.instruct: male, elderly, low pitch, canadian accent
councillor.line: Then the League's autumn contract with Tarsis is void. The Houses may pay their own swords, if they can find the coin.

davin.instruct: male, elderly, moderate pitch, british accent
davin.line: Corran? That's the friend signal. Who've you got with you?

esme.instruct: female, young adult, high pitch, british accent
esme.line: I'll stay at court and play. Somebody has to keep reading the letters. Send for me when you need a tune.

factor.instruct: male, middle-aged, high pitch, american accent
factor.line: The Houses' notes are good. The Houses have never failed to pay.

ferris.instruct: male, young adult, moderate pitch, american accent
ferris.line: First watch? Don't stare at one place. Your eyes start making things up. Look past things, not at them.

finch.instruct: female, young adult, low pitch, british accent
finch.line: And I'm not coming out. Don't ask. There are four hundred in here, and the little ones sleep against me, and if I go they'll take it out on them.

gerd.instruct: male, middle-aged, very low pitch, russian accent
gerd.line: The clans heard you, valley captain. I'll ride south with your Commons when it's time, and every clan that follows me.

gil.instruct: male, young adult, high pitch, british accent
gil.line: Who'd I sell them to? I just... they come to me. They always have. I can't work, nobody hires a fen rat. And the kith don't care what I am.

gully.instruct: male, middle-aged, moderate pitch, australian accent
gully.line: Then I'll show you something I stopped asking about. Tonight, at the end of the mole. Come alone, or as alone as you can.

haldane.instruct: male, elderly, moderate pitch, british accent
haldane.line: A hundred and four volunteers. Ninety-six weaned. Nobody died. Eight went back to the Guild's lulls, which is human, and not the greenlings' fault.

hallet.instruct: male, middle-aged, very low pitch, american accent
hallet.line: Go home, Marshal. It's done. In an hour there won't be a breeding line left in Ostrel. Whatever it cost.

halloran.instruct: male, middle-aged, very low pitch, american accent
halloran.line: The House of Corvel will want to know why its hatchery fell with a Warden lieutenant in the officers' house. I'll tell them. You're finished, Dace.

hessa.instruct: female, middle-aged, moderate pitch, american accent
hessa.line: Shaking. Sweating. Every nerve on fire, for days. So you go back to the shop, and the price has gone up again. It always goes up.

ilse.instruct: female, young adult, moderate pitch, canadian accent
ilse.line: The settling is in the morning. The whole council, and every House's agent. I'm going to read these out. I'd like you standing next to me when I do.

kane.instruct: male, middle-aged, moderate pitch, american accent
kane.line: We're selling the thing people will buy anyway. If they don't buy it from us, they buy it from the Guild, and the Guild's coin builds more hatcheries.

kesh.instruct: male, young adult, low pitch, australian accent
kesh.line: I owe you a month of not being dead. I'll pay it off on foot.

ketti.instruct: female, young adult, high pitch, american accent
ketti.line: There's more in there. Back corner, under the trays. I couldn't carry them all.

khalis.instruct: male, middle-aged, moderate pitch, portuguese accent
khalis.line: Peace in the south, Captain. And when your war is done, come back and tell me how much it cost you to be right.

king.instruct: male, elderly, very low pitch, british accent
king.line: The Guild's envoy will be told that Lorne does not sign. Lorne doesn't buy grazing from people who don't own it. Tell the clans that from me.

lisle.instruct: female, middle-aged, moderate pitch, american accent
lisle.line: House line or field line. The house line will take it all away. The field line takes the edge off. Set at the back of the neck, it reaches the spine.

lyle.instruct: male, young adult, high pitch, american accent
lyle.line: Sergeant? The road was quiet this morning, and I waited by the gate until you came.

maren.instruct: female, elderly, low pitch, british accent
maren.line: Wardens. The Guild's soldiers, in grey coats. That's why you came up blindfolded, and why only Larkfold folk ever walk the cloud path.

nadra.instruct: female, young adult, high pitch, portuguese accent
nadra.line: My father keeps the tin. Rashid will see he gets more. I'll ride with you, Captain. I can't stand in that hall again.

nurse.instruct: female, middle-aged, moderate pitch, american accent
nurse.line: Here, love, give them to me. We'll look after them.

oakes.instruct: male, young adult, low pitch, american accent
oakes.line: I was in Halloran's column. Larkfold. I held the torches. I didn't light any, but I held them for the men who did.

oda.instruct: female, elderly, moderate pitch, british accent
oda.line: I've kept three trays going. Weak ones, the first strengths, for weaning. Is there anyone left to wean?

oren.instruct: male, middle-aged, low pitch, american accent
oren.line: Whatever you decide, decide it so you can live with it in a year. That's all I'll say.

perrine.instruct: female, young adult, low pitch, british accent
perrine.line: Ask the Speaker after, if you want to know. I don't say his name on the stone. It's the one thing I won't do.

posy.instruct: female, young adult, moderate pitch, british accent
posy.line: He said he gave himself to the Guild for Finch. The night watch at the hatcheries, so Finch went to his house and not the carts. Like me.

provost.instruct: male, elderly, low pitch, british accent
provost.line: Moving. The College is not unmoved. But the College must think of the country, and the College's mind is...

rashid.instruct: male, young adult, low pitch, portuguese accent
rashid.line: I have friends among the guards' sons. With greenlings for the old guards and their fathers, the guard is mine in a month, and my brother is a guest i

reeve.instruct: female, middle-aged, low pitch, american accent
reeve.line: I'm Aske, reeve of this town, which means these people voted me in and can vote me out. Say your piece, Lieutenant. They'll decide.

rhea.instruct: female, young adult, moderate pitch, british accent
rhea.line: Already made up. I know. It was made up for you a month ago, in Vantry. Would the College like to see who wrote it?

rook.instruct: male, elderly, low pitch, british accent
rook.line: They didn't come up the trail. They came out of the cloud, by the cloud gate, quiet as you like. Old Davin on the cloud gate opened it for them. He th

sela.instruct: female, young adult, very high pitch, british accent
sela.line: Then last week a clerk said the sorting house was full, and put me in this one.

soldier.instruct: male, young adult, moderate pitch, american accent
soldier.line: They hanged your elders from their own drying house, Sergeant. We all heard. What do you want to do with the men who held the light for it?

speaker.instruct: female, elderly, moderate pitch, british accent
speaker.line: Hollin takes the Guild's offer, by eleven hands. The gates of the Free Towns close to the war. The town keeps what it votes.

tam.instruct: female, young adult, very high pitch, american accent
tam.line: And the rider. The one they called Ninety. He came in on the trays last week, same as us. They took his coat and gave him his number back.

tamsin.instruct: female, young adult, high pitch, british accent
tamsin.line: You will, one day. And it'll be him. And he'll be older, and different, and you'll have to get to know him again. Start getting ready for that now.

tobin.instruct: male, middle-aged, low pitch, british accent
tobin.line: I've had the raw three times, Ma. I can't do it a fourth.

ume.instruct: female, elderly, high pitch, british accent
ume.line: He's tried three times to come off them on his own, up here, in the cold. The raw sends him back down the mountain every time.

varro.instruct: female, middle-aged, low pitch, american accent
varro.line: The Mire boy, Tam, says the Broodhouse drain comes out at Cinderwick, by Mire's. There's a grate at the top. Locked, from their side.

vela.instruct: female, middle-aged, low pitch, australian accent
vela.line: The whole company, then. Every sword. For the season.

warden2.instruct: male, young adult, low pitch, american accent
warden2.line: Names, Dace. Three or four names. Then this is yours, and you can sleep tonight.

weaver.instruct: female, middle-aged, low pitch, british accent
weaver.line: My sister took your greenling in the spring, captain. She and her husband. They died in the same week, because the brood came out wrong and nobody kne

wren.instruct: female, young adult, very high pitch, american accent
wren.line: Six of us. Six didn't come out. The officer on watch was asleep. Everybody says so. He was wearing one, under his collar.
